retrievalProfile.description: Generates a retro 1980s music cover featuring a central musician in a leather jacket with high-contrast condensed typography and a secondary cursive script.
triggerTerms: condensed tall typography with script overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A portrait-oriented composition featuring a musician with curly hair and aviator sunglasses, wearing a dark leather jacket, set against a bright, slightly textured wall. The layout is defined by a top-left typographic block consisting of ultra-condensed, tall sans-serif letters underlined by a thick red bar, with a fluid, handwritten script layered below.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned right-of-center to balance top-left typography
High-contrast red horizontal bar anchoring the primary text
Juxtaposition of rigid geometric sans-serif and organic cursive script
Warm, soft-focus lighting on the subject against a neutral background
coreInvariants: Thick red horizontal rule separating text elements
Musician in leather jacket with aviator sunglasses

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Musician occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, medium shot from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red horizontal bar in the top-left corner acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold typography top-left, follows the red bar to the subject's face, then down to the instrument.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant bright negative space in the upper left and right margins to allow text to breathe.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red (Horizontal Bar and Graphic Element)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value background with high saturation accent and low value subject.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Circular graphic element integrated behind the central letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast juxtaposition of rigid verticality and fluid horizontal script.
graphicDevices: Circular red graphic emblem behind text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed verticality of the display type.
Captures the casual, handwritten feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a man with dark curly hair and aviator sunglasses wearing a dark brown leather jacket, holding a saxophone, standing against a bright off-white textured wall with soft lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed tall black uppercase text in the top left. Place a thick red horizontal bar directly beneath it. Below the bar, add a flowing black cursive script.

verificationChecks: Is the display text extremely tall and narrow?
Is there a thick red bar separating the two text styles?
Is the subject wearing aviators and a leather jacket?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Exact facial features of the musician
postGenerationChecks: Check that the red bar is perfectly horizontal and thick.
Ensure the script text does not touch the red bar.
Verify the display text is vertically stretched.
Confirm the lighting on the subject is soft and warm.
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Portrait + Ultra-Condensed Sans + Red Bar + Script Overlay
